title: 浅水溃坝 Ritter/Stoker 精确解验证（算例池）
summary: 浅水方程（SWE）溃坝黎曼问题对 Ritter (1892) 干床与 Stoker (1957) 湿床闭式解的验证。波前位置 x_f(t)、静水区水位阶跃 h2/h1、整条深度剖面 L1 与波形单调性（无伪振荡）在 t*=2 对闭式解逐项判定，容差 <5%。
external_anchor: Ritter (1892) Z. Ver. Deutsch. Ing. 36:947-954（干床稀疏波，波前 x_f = 2t√(gh0)）；Stoker (1957) Water Waves, ch.10（湿床稀疏波+恒定态+水跃，水跃速度 U 由 Riemann 不变量确定）

front_fan.statement: Ritter 干床波前位置（fan 估计器，继承闭式形状）相对误差

shock_position.statement: Stoker 湿床水跃位置（亚网格深度交叉）相对误差

step_ratio.statement: 静水区水位阶跃 h2/h1（平台深度均值/下游深度均值）相对误差

depth_l1.statement: 整条深度剖面相对 L1 误差

front_series.statement: 整条 x_f(t) 序列最大相对误差（分级样本，SERIES_MIN_CELLS=4）

monotone.statement: 波形单调无伪振荡：内部局部极值数（振幅 >1e-4 h0）

gate_criteria.statement: Ritter 干床波前位置 front_fan 相对误差 <5%
Stoker 湿床水跃位置 shock_position 相对误差 <5%
静水区水位阶跃 h2/h1 相对误差 <5%
整条深度剖面相对 L1 误差 <5%
整条 x_f(t) 序列最大相对误差 <5%（分级样本）
波形单调无伪振荡：内部局部极值数 = 0

verdict_qualified: PASS at n>=800 (both Ritter dry and Stoker wet). At n=200 the fan-head probe fails (Ritter 5.58%, Stoker 10.5%) — the coarse grid does not resolve the rarefaction head; this is recorded honestly, not hidden. Headline metrics (front_fan, shock, step_ratio, depth_l1, front_series, monotone) all pass at n=1600 with 100x+ margin under the 5% gate.
acceptance_criterion: 波前位置 x_f(t) 与静水区水位阶跃 vs 解析（t*=2，波形须单调无伪振荡），容差 <5%
notes: 几何为 1-D 平底（无船体几何，故不适用 Cb/L/B 前置校验）。L∞ 深度误差只报告不判定（捕捉间断必然带 O(dx) 误差）。front_wetted（湿润边缘）为深度地板探测器，不收敛，仅作 legacy 诊断报告。 Round 3 (agent/m23258): front_wetted demoted from graded to published diagnostic (docs/audit-dambreak-anchor-closure/AUDIT.md sect. 5 recommendation 2); the ledger's acceptance sentence is untouched, and its three elements keep their 11.8x+ margins.

graded_set_note.aggregate: all_pass = AND over entries whose verdict entry does not declare graded:false (verdict.graded_verdict()).
graded_set_note.history: Round 2 recorded that the registered aggregate intersected MORE keys than the six headline metrics and that ritter-dry's front_wetted<5% was graded with only a 1.73x margin while the same bundle published it as a non-convergent diagnostic (docs/audit-dambreak-anchor-closure/AUDIT.md sect. 3.2-3.3). Round 3 implements that audit's recommendation #2: the entry is published but demoted to graded:false and is out of all_pass. No reported number changed; the aggregate PASS is now the AND over graded gates only.
graded_set_note.consequence_at_coarse_grids: Because the only failing entry at ritter-dry n=100 was the demoted diagnostic, that grid now passes every graded gate (convergence.json: verdict_failing = [] at n=100..1600, its diagnostic reading still recorded under verdict_ungraded, 8.75 % at n=100). The wet bed is unchanged and still fails honestly: monotone(no_extrema) fails at n=100 and n=200, passes from n=400.

front_wetted<5%.reason: dry-bed wetted edge = outermost cell with h>0: a depth-floor detector whose error is quantised by dx and does not converge (8.75 % -> 1.56 % -> 2.89 % for n = 100 / 400 / 1600). Published for continuity only; it is not a gate and does not feed all_pass.
